messages:
alex: Noticing a weird one - after publishing 2.2.0 (tightened exports) a few sample apps in our deno + cloudflare workers matrix fail with missing types at runtime. Anyone familiar with TS-only imports and exports map interactions?

rita: hmm, missing types at runtime? can you paste the error?

alex: error in worker build: `Could not resolve \"./types/index.d.ts\" for package \"@redwood/sdk\"` and in Deno: `Import specifier \"@redwood/sdk\" failed to resolve` when using `import type` in a sample. Locally node + tsc is fine.

sam: quick guess: exports map doesn't expose the types path, and some bundlers try to resolve .d.ts during build (esbuild/deno bundler). We've seen Deno try to fetch package.json and then subpath.

nathan: can you show package.json exports from 2.2.0?

alex: current exports in 2.2.0: 

```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./esm/index.mjs", "require": "./cjs/index.cjs" }
}
```

and root has "types": "types/index.d.ts" but no types entry under exports.

rita: yeah that's the issue. With an exports map present, some consumers won't fall back to the top-level types field. Tools like Deno/ESBuild/ESLint that try to resolve type imports may attempt to load `@redwood/sdk/types` or `@redwood/sdk/package.json` and get blocked.

dawn: there's also the nuance that `import type` can still trigger module resolution in some setups (tsserver / vscode) and if VS Code tries to resolve `@redwood/sdk` for intellisense and hits exports, it stops.

ci-bot: CI matrix note: failing jobs: deno-1.36, cloudflare-node-compat, esbuild-0.18 bundle.

sam: short term fix: add explicit `types` entry under `exports` and export a `./types` or `./*` mapping. e.g.

```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "types": "./types/index.d.ts", "import": "./esm/index.mjs", "require": "./cjs/index.cjs", "default": "./esm/index.mjs" },
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
```

rita: I prefer `./types` explicit export rather than `./*` to avoid exposing internals. Also add `typesVersions` to help older TS resolver fallbacks.

nathan: we should also think about deno compatibility - Deno doesn't use node exports map, but when people use npm specifiers in deno.json importMap, it resolves via CDN which may rely on package.json. To be safe, publish types at top-level `index.d.ts` and keep `types` field pointing there.

dawn: we should add a minimal deno sample into our sample-apps CI that imports the sdk (using import maps) to catch this in future.

alex: agree. I'll prepare 2.2.1 with the types export and a tiny fix: copy `types/index.d.ts` to `types.d.ts` at root during build so older resolvers work. Also add docs about compatible runtimes.

sam: also add a lint in the package build that fails the release if exports exist but `./package.json` or `types` aren't exported. We had that lint previously, but it missed the deno nuance.

ci-bot: New patch release queued: 2.2.1 (includes exports/types rework) by alex.

rita: post-release, send a short note to support + add migration snippet for monorepos that use symlinks and pnpm. People often try `import '@redwood/sdk/types'` which we don't want to encourage.

alex: copying action items: 1) republish 2.2.1 with explicit types export + root types copy, 2) add deno/worker sample to CI, 3) add build lint for exports+types, 4) doc snippet. Will open PRs.

nathan: thanks. also include bun in CI if possible (bun's resolver is picky).

alex: will do. thanks all.
